Gui.label: 规
Gui.material: 摩擦噪声/回旋谱扫主导，非钟体
Gui.physical_approximation: Three overlapping filtered-noise friction bands follow one curved spectral sweep; one light initial touch.
Gui.distinguishing_axis: 宽带粗糙摩擦 + 高频向内收拢的连续运动

Ju.label: 矩
Ju.role: 两记干木尺相合，第二记锁定
Ju.material: 干木接触 + 极短低Q木体
Ju.physical_approximation: Two independent short band-limited wood contacts and heavily damped signed modes, 95ms apart.
Ju.envelope: 两音头间隔95ms，第二记重音，两个木击尾均截止到70ms
Ju.distinguishing_axis: 有意双击节奏；不是两次成印事件

Zhun.label: 准
Zhun.material: 短石质点触 + 极短浅下滑共鸣
Zhun.physical_approximation: A short rough point contact plus rapidly damped low-Q shallow pitch-settling modes, not a cartoon water drop.
Zhun.envelope: 单个清点，前25ms浅下滑，145ms前收住
Zhun.distinguishing_axis: 孤立短点、轻清收定；无长钟尾/水泡弹性

Sheng.label: 绳
Sheng.material: Karplus–Strong拨弦近似 + 干纤维摩擦
Sheng.physical_approximation: Single seeded noise excitation of a lossy delay loop; delayed-difference pluck-position filter; overlapping fiber tension friction.
Sheng.envelope: 一次拨动，约140ms绷紧余振与纤维短擦，干燥收尾
Sheng.distinguishing_axis: 短谐波梳状弦体 + 纤维质地；不使用钟的非谐模态族

Heng.label: 衡
Heng.material: 厚闷落座 + 低Q杆体 + 短机械摩擦
Heng.physical_approximation: Dense low-mid filtered impact and heavily damped bar modes, with a quiet continuous settling rub instead of a second hit.
Heng.envelope: 单个厚落座，后接轻微机械余动，约200ms止住
Heng.distinguishing_axis: 中低频实体重量，保留350–1800Hz小扬声器线索
